title: Move webui phase configurations to bottom
description: I would like the phase configurations (agent and model) to be moved to the bottom of the client page, ideally in a collapsible element.
plan:
## What
Move the phase configuration UI (agent and model settings per pipeline phase) from its current position near the top of the client page to the bottom, wrapped in a collapsible HTML element that is collapsed by default.

## Why
The phase settings are rarely changed configuration that currently takes up prominent screen real estate near the top. Moving them to the bottom in a collapsible element keeps the focus on the primary content (agent status and feature cards) while still making settings accessible when needed.

## Impact
- The client page layout changes so phase settings appear after features and scripts sections
- No backend changes needed — same data, same API calls
- The settings JavaScript (population of selects, save handler) moves with the HTML block

## Risks
- Minimal: this is a pure UI layout change with no functional impact

## Scope
- In scope: Moving the phase settings block and wrapping it in a native HTML <details>/<summary> collapsible element
- Out of scope: Redesigning the settings UI, changing the save behavior, or adding new settings
plan_exploration_summary: Examined server/templates/client.html which is the main client page template. The phase settings section (agent and model configuration per phase) was located between the agent status cards and the Features section (around lines 379-465). The page uses Go HTML templates with inline styles and JavaScript. The codebase already uses collapsible patterns via custom toggleCollapsible/makeCollapsibleSection functions for feature detail sections, but also uses native HTML <details>/<summary> elements would be appropriate here for a standalone collapsible section. The phase settings consist of a grid of rows, each with a phase label, agent select dropdown, model override input, and save button, populated via JavaScript from Go template data.
